scope: Original Parkes July 31 and September 12 2025, blc00, four physical IF indices, four 128-channel windows, original Source and Reference

primary_shift.interpretation: Strong narrowband/persistent structure in identical frequency windows of July Source and Reference, present in multiple IF numerical products; likely RFI or instrument/common observing-path structure; NOT demonstrated celestial source or confirmed RFI origin.
primary_shift.inference_limit: Physical native IF / polarization (Stokes) identities not externally attested; negative cross-correlations do not uniquely reveal polarization or instrument physics.

additional_distributions.note: July retrospective p95 is diagnostic only, not a selected replacement threshold. High score is specific to channel structure, not merely absolute power gain: the 806MHz raw-power medians are comparable across dates.

study_limits: Only 4 windows x 128 frequency bins out of 64000 channels per IF, not the full receiver band.
4 native IF indices inspected, but exact polarization/Stokes semantics unverified.
Control examples are correlated injections/no-injection repeats from 8 parent windows per observing date; n=192 is not n=192 independent tests.
July was already used for development and September for calibration; no prospective independent transfer validation.
Source and Reference names from archive do not establish telescope antenna encoder pointing.
A failed July cross-date hold does not prove RFI origin or any ETI signal.

decision.next: Qualify native IF/polarization semantics from independent instrument docs and measured pointing; measure matched Source/Reference interference identity with predeclared frequency-alignment diagnostics on July and September only. If considering any robust score change or band veto, preregister and validate on independent new data without using sealed October.
